visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman stand against a plain white wall. The woman has long, reddish-brown hair and wears a black t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial movements. The man, wearing glasses and a black tank top, stands behind her and flexes his biceps. (2) The woman holds up a smartphone showing a video of circus acrobats performing a complex tower formation. The man leans in to look at the screen, showing a focused facial expression. (3) The scene shifts to a living room with a large TV and white flooring. The woman attempts to jump into the man's arms for an acrobatic move, but they stumble, and she ends up sitting on the floor laughing. (4) In the same room, the pair talks to each other while standing. The woman gestures with her hands while the man listens attentively, standing in a relaxed posture. (5) They attempt the move again. The man grabs the woman's legs and waist, spinning her upward until she successfully sits on his shoulders. (6) While on his shoulders, the woman laughs and holds onto his head, looking slightly unstable and excited. The man holds her legs firmly to stabilize her. (7) Back to a standing position, they continue their conversation, pointing and gesturing towards the camera. (8) A sequence of more complex lifts is shown. The man lifts the woman into various inverted positions. They both show high energy and joy, often breaking into laughter after attempts. Text bubbles and emoji overlays appear frequently. (9) A polished montage follows where they perform the acrobatic sequence successfully, including a transition where she is lifted high and then caught. (10) They celebrate by hugging and smiling broadly. (11) The final scene shows them back in front of the white wall, pointing towards an on-screen graphic advertising a circus performance called 'Humans 2.0'.
